title: Scholarships: corporate and trust
summary: Aditya Birla, Inlaks, OPJEMS, ST Engineering, Shipping Corporation, TODAI, Nissan, DRDO.

posts.md:
In addition to institute and government scholarships, several companies, trusts, and organizations offer scholarships to IIT Madras students based on academic performance, JEE rank, department, or other eligibility criteria.

## Aditya Birla Scholarship

**Eligibility**

* Selection by the **Aditya Birla Group** from the **Top 20 JEE Rank** holders.

**Benefits**

* ₹60,000/year
* Renewable as per Aditya Birla Group norms

## Inlaks Scholarship

**Eligibility**

* **CGPA ≥ 9.0** at the end of the **2nd semester**
* Selection by a committee
* One scholarship awarded

**Benefits**

* ₹25,000/semester for **4 years**

## OPJEMS Scholarship

**Eligibility**

* First Year: Selection among **Top 20 JEE Rank** holders
* Higher Years: Based on **CGPA** among the top students

**Benefits**

* ₹65,000/year

## ST Engineering Scholarship

**Eligibility**

* Two B.Tech students each from **II, III & IV Year**
* Among the **Top 10%** students of **Aerospace Engineering (AE), Computer Science (CS), and Mechanical Engineering (ME)**

**Benefits**

* ₹80,000/year

## Shipping Corporation of India Scholarship

**Eligibility**

* **SC/ST/BPL** students of **B.Tech Naval Architecture**

**Benefits**

* ₹48,000/year **or**
* Full Tuition Fee & Hostel Charges

## TODAI Scholarship

**Eligibility**

* Two B.Tech students each from **I, II, III & IV Year**
* Open to **AE, EE & ME** students with excellent academic performance

**Benefits**

* **2,00,000 Japanese Yen/year**

## Nissan Scholarship

**Eligibility**

* Two **B.Tech/Dual Degree** students from **III & IV Year**

**Benefits**

* ₹70,000/year

## DAE, DGFS Scholarship (DRDO)

**Eligibility**

* **B.Tech Aerospace Engineering** students
* Minimum **CGPA of 7.0**
* Based on **JEE Rank**

**Benefits**

* ₹5,000/month for **4 years**
* One-time Book Allowance of **₹10,000**

### Important Notes

* Selection is based on the criteria defined by the sponsoring organization.
* Some scholarships require maintaining a minimum CGPA for renewal.
* Availability and eligibility may change from year to year.
